theorems.name: Submission.fiw_fcl_nested_subseq
theorems.statement: ∀ (Q : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Prop), (∀ r : ℕ, ∀ J : Set ℕ, J.Infinite → ∃ J' ⊆ J, J'.Infinite ∧ ∀ i ∈ J', ∀ j ∈ J', Q r i j) → ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ ∀ r : ℕ, Q r (φ r) (φ (r + 1))
